summary:
Research of w109 done; notes.md in the stage directory has parts 1-7.
15 accepted test ids run one by one: 7 PASS (r1 x2, r20 deprecated x2, r20 share-a-file outline x3), 8 FAIL on undefined steps (r59, r60 x2, r62, r20 own worktree, r20 workers-2, r61, r63).
Probes (run): blocked_by w1 still gets four workers while w2 is awaiting-answer (D2); session.json holds no transcript path; five drafted items with a workers key run one at a time; malformed delivery.toml ends with a traceback and leaves an uncommitted start line (D1).
No tests-of map: test lists are by search. Refs used for names.
Conflicts: retired scenarios (feature 8 and 430) assert serial stages and a limit of two, which r59 and r60's default of 4 break.
File set: supervise.py (room 37), supervise_worker.py, supervise_merge.py, supervise_review.py, supervise_faults.py; supervision_then_workers.py has room 15, so new steps need a new module.
For the plan: the name of the workers key in delivery.toml (unnamed in spec; the w101 plan proposed `workers`); whether the branch reviewer's session.json counts for r62 (Q2); whether D1 is in this work-item's scope.
